title: RAW full f83r loan account under one six-production prefix grammar, with seven meanings frozen
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_A_COMPLETE_READING. Retain the whole72-group f83r P1 source, its seven guessed values at20 positions, and all52 still unglossed positions. A new exact six-production prefix grammar must cover every group with one type/valency per whole form. Normative permission, return duty and continuing title are state assertions; the written custody delivery is an event with the same borrower argument. No new word values, full parse or legal translation are supplied here.

design.new_construction_notation: N is a typed entity/reference noun; p0 is a zero-spoken-argument state predicate; p1/p2 are predicates with one/two spoken N arguments. Each exact whole form has one category, one fixed arity and one full denotation across all occurrences and readers. No type is selected by locus. The inherited loan role frame R=(A asset,B title holder,C borrower) is explicit context, not an unlimited supply of hidden entities.

exact_six_productions.reduction: Return the noun’s fixed typed referent. A noun must be consumed as an argument of G3 or G4; no stand-alone nominal clause or ignored topic is available.

Assert the fixed state/modal proposition against the persistent loan frame R. Only the three old state predicates chedy, qokedy and qoteedy may belong to P0; no new zero-argument filler predicate is allowed.
Apply the predicate to that one following typed argument, with the fixed R slots declared by its full denotation. No argument may be silently consumed from a neighboring clause.
Apply the predicate to the two following typed arguments in written order. Reversing them is a different rule and not available.

Compose clauses in written order. State assertions add constraints/permissions; only an event predicate changes its declared state. Repeating the same assertion repeats its obligation, never silently creating another transfer.

design.production_account: Exactly six separately listed right-hand sides, including the two text alternatives and the noun production. No optional slots, adjective rules, articles, postposed alternative, conjunction token, quotation, free topic, clause macro, NULL, packed group, insertion, deletion or raw-line selector. Prefix order is a new exploratory assumption, not a recovered Voynich grammar. Any required extra ordered production closes this particular bounded offer; it cannot be hidden under a family name.

chedy.denotation: Permitted(C,Use(A)) as a modal assertion; no Use(A) event and no custody update.

qokedy.denotation: Owes(C,Return(A,B)) as a duty; no actual Return event and no custody update.

qoteedy.denotation: Title(A)=B persists in this loan; an assertion, not a new purchase or title transfer.

qokeedy.argument_constraint: The spoken following recipient must be C, the same borrower denoted by the old value.
qokeedy.denotation: The old delivery of custody of A to C. Its spoken argument redundantly identifies the already fixed C; it cannot choose another recipient. It updates custody to C and leaves title and return duty unchanged.

two_known_local_obligations_not_a_parse.meaning: Deliver custody of the same A to the same C; not title transfer. This already printed local sequence is one motivation, not a successful entire parse.
Two written assertions of the same continuing title. Both positions are consumed; there are no two legal transfers or omitted repetitions.

design.whole_content_offer: Complete the old one-asset loan account: B retains title while C receives custody, permission to use and a duty to return. Earlier and later normative clauses must concern the same A/B/C record. The entire paragraph, including every currently unknown word, must state or qualify this arrangement under the one grammar. A completed reading is allowed to expose incompatibility; the desired final state is not a parsing oracle.
nonfree_reference_and_state_obligations: A, B and C are the old role-bound referents, not freely reassigned per line. Any additional participant or asset is a new explicit whole value and binding, and cannot replace an old noun’s fixed referent.

Before an actual custody-changing event can be evaluated, its current holder/source must be stated by the complete reading or left explicitly unbound. Title holder B is not automatically the initial custodian. The first event cannot create a favorable initial account merely from its precondition.

Normative P0 assertions never advance physical/legal event time or execute their embedded Use/Return action. All actual changes must be predicates with a declared event effect, and every such new lexical value is separately counted.

Every new P1/P2 value denotes one reusable operation or relation with declared argument sorts, not an entire hidden sequence, a phrase-specific legal story or a lookup of the desired outcome. No new P0 values or aliases of the three old state predicates are admitted.

All old exact matches in the whole IT record keep the same types/values; alternative raw forms stay unknown unless included as separately costed new whole values. No reader-specific valency or spacing repair.
design.distinct_falsifier: After a complete lexical offer is authored and frozen, every one of the72 ZL groups and every71 IT group must be consumed under these six patterns with identical form categories/arities. If a repeated form must be a noun in one occurrence and a predicate or different-arity head in another, or an old noun remains outside every argument slot, this specific compact grammar fails even when a free narrative sounds plausible. The complete state/reference account may separately fail or remain unbound. No parser run or satisfiability claim is made in this card.

rivals_and_limits.content: The entire account can describe obligations and a schematic delivery without asserting that a real transaction took place. The offered imperative/event reduction is a new construction choice, not established by the seven values. If the text needs a quotation, conditional or generic scope constructor, that is a substantive construction outside these six patterns, not a gratis repair.
A postfix or mixed grammar may carry the same seven meanings even if this prefix grammar fails. It remains an unbuilt rival; no universal grammar refutation follows.

Other whole-content families may reinterpret ownership or custody and remain possible manuscript hypotheses. Their meanings are not mixed with this fixed loan offer, and source plausibility alone does not select the legal account.

strongest_countercases: The current input is not an old complete reading:52 positions remain unglossed. Seven inherited values at20 positions do not supply a complete legal account or a full parse.

W41’s local working handoff succeeds under one old reference choice but fails elsewhere and leaves four qoky without recipients. Its qoky work-resumption, heating and material meanings are not inherited by this independent loan family.
The old loan proposal itself states that qoteedy qoteedy needs grammar. G2/G6 supply one explicit new conjunctive-assertion construction, not evidence that this is its historical use.
No specific legal source has been identified for the loan story. The old charter card is architectural background, not a charter that says this exact loan account.

A prefix grammar with only noun arguments cannot express arbitrary embedding. This is deliberate finite scope, not proof that the manuscript lacks conditionals or that every additional function word is meaningless.
